lines.text: The LORD tells Ezekiel to declare the abominations of Oholah and Oholibah, who committed adultery with their idols.
They sacrificed their children in the fire to idols, then entered God's sanctuary the same day to profane it.
When the men from afar arrived, the sisters bathed and painted their eyes, then set God's gold and silver on a table.
Drunkards from the desert put bracelets on their wrists, and wealthy men will sentence them for adultery and bloodshed.
A mob will stone them, cut them down with swords, and burn down their houses, and then they will know He is the Lord GOD.
